name: 2.0.0-test-rc8 focused checklist
description: Focused acceptance checks for changes added after the RC7 test image.

items.name: RC8 identity and clean startup
items.description: Test: 1) Record whether this is a fresh install or update and the exact image/commit. 2) Open the dashboard footer, GET /api/health, GET /api/system, and GET /api/plugins. 3) Create a uniquely named Review note or plugin record, restart once, and reopen the same workspace. Pass: Health is HTTP 200, dashboard and /api/system report 2.0.0-test-rc8 without a stale RC tag, packaged metadata matches, /api/plugins lists the intended inventory, and the uniquely named state survives restart.

items.name: Three clear Review sets
items.description: Test: 1) Open Review > Suggested without starting a set. 2) Confirm the available set names and counts, open each set's details, and read at least three checks from each. 3) Start all three, switch their Active release tabs, and refresh. Pass: Exactly 1.9.9 regression, 2.0.0 previous RCs, and 2.0.0-test-rc8 are offered; every row contains actionable Test steps plus an objective Pass result; prior verification is labeled without auto-completing the current tester's row; and all three remain separate after refresh.

items.name: Separate Suggested discovery
items.description: Test: 1) In Guardrails, Evals, Optimize, and Review record the counts on Active, Archived, and Suggested. 2) In Suggested search for a known title fragment, apply one tag/filter, change sort order, and open a suggestion's details. 3) Choose Use once, edit the created item, then archive it. Pass: Suggested entries never leak into Active, search/filter/sort change only the intended collection and counts, details identify the selected suggestion, Use returns to an editable Active record without duplicates, and archiving moves only that record to Archived.

items.name: Fast cached suggestions
items.description: Test: 1) Hard-refresh, open Suggested in each enabled plugin, and note first-load time. 2) Navigate to Agents and back to each Suggested tab three times, watching for blank/loading states. 3) If you can edit or mount a suggestion file, add a uniquely named test suggestion, verify it is absent before refresh, then choose Actions > Refresh. Pass: Initial loading resolves normally, every revisit paints the retained suggestions immediately rather than showing the prior multi-second blank state, navigation stays responsive, and explicit Refresh bypasses the cache and shows the uniquely named change.

items.name: Persistent plugin navigation order
items.description: Test: 1) In the first browser profile, reorder at least three plugin entries and move Review away from last. 2) Refresh, close/reopen the tab, and switch workspace if available. 3) Open the same instance in a clean/incognito profile without copying local storage. Pass: The first profile restores its exact custom order through refresh/reopen/workspace switch, the clean profile uses manifest defaults with Review last, ordering one profile does not affect the other, and every entry still opens the correct plugin.

items.name: Review export handoff
items.description: Test: 1) In one release set, pass one row, fail one, leave one pending with notes, and add at least one evidence URL/path. 2) Choose Export, enter reviewer name/email, select the actual local/cloud/on-prem environment, and download the Markdown. 3) Open the file and compare its table, summary totals, metadata, filename, and recent-error section with the UI; search it for a known secret/key sentinel if one is safely available. Pass: The filename names only the selected release, totals and every outcome/note/evidence value match, reviewer/time/host/platform/workspace/version/environment are present, recent errors are useful and deduplicated/sanitized, and no secret value is exported.

items.name: Mobile plugin toolbar and dialogs
items.description: Test: 1) Use iPhone Safari or a 390x844 viewport and open each enabled plugin from the mobile sidebar. 2) In every plugin switch Active/Archived/Suggested and all available views, then open search/filter, Actions, Create/AI Create, one detail, and any run/confirmation dialog. 3) In Review open notes editing and Export, scroll each long dialog to its final action, rotate once if using a phone, and return to Agents. Pass: Toolbars occupy stable rows, tabs scroll without widening the page, Create/Actions and final dialog actions remain reachable above browser chrome, dialog bodies scroll independently, long text wraps, no horizontal clipping/overlap occurs, and navigation remains usable.

items.name: Automated and image release gate
items.description: Test: 1) Run ./SYSTEM/test-with-server.sh integration --with-validation --coverage against the candidate and save totals plus coverage percentages. 2) Open the candidate CI run and verify test, amd64, arm64, manifest, public smoke, and private-combined jobs as applicable. 3) Pull the exact public image and, with authorized package credentials, the combined private image; check /api/health, /api/system, /api/plugins, diagnostics, and restart persistence in each. Pass: The local suite has zero failures and no unexplained coverage regression, every required job is green, both architectures are in the published manifest, versions match 2.0.0-test-rc8, public/private inventories respect their source boundary, and both images remain healthy after restart.
